resolver_requery_law.static_channel: Schedule exact ContextResolver next_context_change boundary from current resolver receipt; after refresh replace prospective current context binding and schedule newly returned boundary if any.
resolver_requery_law.generated_channel: After committed V3 generated fact changes accepted query-binding fingerprint, schedule same-time dependent GENERATED_STATE_REQUERY against the same immutable repository bundle unless governing policy explicitly selects a new immutable bundle.
resolver_requery_law.coalescing: Static and generated requery at same actor/query/time may coalesce only with same repository/policy and newest already-committed binding fingerprint; receipt retains all trigger reasons.
forbidden_retroactivity: turn new structural availability into earlier lived exposure
resolver_requery_law.nonprogress: Identical next boundary <= current time that recreates same unconsumed trigger identity fails SCHEDULER_NONPROGRESSING_CONTEXT_BOUNDARY.
